authorship.statement: This formal pack was authored by an independent non-implementation author. No R1 policy, thresholds, or implementation were modified. No development-pack results were inspected. Queries were not tuned against implementation behavior. No enforcement code was created. Development and formal evidence are not aggregated.

rules: Every scored query must identify at least one accepted evidence neighborhood entry unless abstention_expected is true.
Every scored query must declare whether lower-cost enforcement is allowed.
Every scored query must declare the expected fallback behavior if the lower-cost route cannot satisfy lineage or evidence coverage.
No scored query may be authored or edited by the implementation team.
